ai_summary: Advanced Enzyme Technologies Ltd. reported its daily share buyback activity, repurchasing 49,647 equity shares on October 15, 2026, at an average price of ₹269.0964. This brings the cumulative total of shares bought back under the ongoing open market program to 2,003,307. This routine disclosure indicates the company's consistent execution of its buyback initiative, which typically aims to return capital to shareholders and can enhance earnings per share by reducing the number of outstanding shares; no red flags are evident in this standard regulatory filing.
